# Gridiron

> Every game, every drive, one view. A live football command centre: scores, win
> probability, drive charts and a field diagram for each game, with the moments that
> matter surfaced as they happen.

Every spot, clock and chance comes from a source that reported it. A missing ball
spot says so; it is never guessed to midfield.

## What it shows

- A card per game: score, possession, down and distance, red zone, and the field.
- Win probability and the published lines beside it, each named with its source.
- Moments: scoring plays, big plays and fourth-down stops, as they are reported.
- Watch next: the games where a tying or go-ahead chance is live right now.
